tasks.description: Identify at least 5 members of the executive and senior leadership team of the target organisation. Prioritise core roles such as CEO, CFO, CTO, COO, CMO, CIO, and Group/Global Heads (e.g., Group Chief Human Resources Officer). Primary focus must be on the target organisation; secondary focus may include a small number of relevant executive roles from the parent or group organisation if leadership overlaps. For each person, provide full name, official title, organisation, and a brief professional background (previous roles, experience, or tenure).

Provide a clear overview of what the target organisation does. Identify its primary business model, key services and solutions, core product offerings (if any), and the main industries or market segments it serves. Focus on factual descriptions drawn from official sources, company profiles, or reputable business references. Avoid marketing language.

Determine the current organisational size of the target organisation. Include approximate employee count, number of offices or branches, key geographic locations, and global presence if applicable. Use the most recent data available and clearly distinguish confirmed figures from estimates.

Identify recent significant business engagements involving the target organisation. This includes funding rounds, strategic partnerships, collaborations, mergers, acquisitions, major client deals, or publicly announced agreements. For each engagement, include the year, involved parties, nature of the engagement, and its business relevance.

Analyse the target organisation’s current strategic focus areas. Highlight initiatives such as AI adoption, cloud transformation, digital modernisation, automation, data platforms, cybersecurity, or other major technology or business priorities. Base findings on recent announcements, leadership statements, partnerships, or published materials.
